findings.claim: Server transcript load failures are silently converted to an empty transcript instead of exposing an error state.
findings.evidence: The added runtime-data-sync requirement says "Load and mutation failures SHALL be exposed to the page as an error state with the runtime's message"; `fetchSessionMessages` returns `[]` on any non-OK response (`if (!res.ok) return [];`) and `useChatMessages` only reads `transcript?.messages`, so the entity read cannot surface the HTTP failure.
findings.suggested_fix: Throw an Error containing the response/runtime message on non-2xx so `useEntity` records an error and callers can surface it, or explicitly return an error state from `useChatMessages`.

findings.claim: The non-TanStack `useActiveThread` export was deleted even though the accepted deletion scope only names dead thread query hooks.
findings.evidence: The acceptance criteria and proposal allow deleting `useThreads`/`useThreadDetail`/`useCreateThread`/`useDeleteThread` in `use-threads.ts`, but the diff also removes `useActiveThread`, which was a plain store wrapper (`activeThreadId`, `setActiveThread`) and not a TanStack-based query hook.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep `useActiveThread` unless a repo-wide consumer check proves it is dead and the accepted scope is updated to include it.

findings.claim: The new user settings graph hooks have no accompanying tests despite the tests-for-new-features warning constraint.
findings.evidence: Constraint `tests-for-new-features` says tests should exist for new hooks, stores and utilities; the diff adds `src/hooks/use-user-settings.ts` and modifies `user-settings-page.tsx`, but no `use-user-settings.test.tsx` or equivalent coverage is added.
findings.suggested_fix: Add tests covering initial load, disabled JWT behavior, save success updating the graph, and save/load error exposure.
